context-summary.description: Project context summary prepared for downstream reasoning.

requirement.description: Normalized user requirement for this run.

issue-context.description: GitHub issue body, metadata, and repository binding for issue-driven runs.

worktree-info.description: Branch, run id, worktree path, and artifact directory metadata.

spec.description: Approved specification of user-visible goals and acceptance criteria.

plan-parts.description: Split plan part documents when a plan exceeds the configured threshold.

tech-design.description: Optional technical design appendix produced by planning.

test-plan.description: Acceptance checklist and optional TDD skeleton map.

tasks-dir.description: Per-task markdown files generated by tasking.

task-group.description: Task dependency graph and batching manifest.

code-change.description: Source changes made in the run worktree.

review-report.description: Review findings and residual risk summary.

stage-artifact.description: The primary artifact produced earlier in the current stage, resolved by runtime.

gate-result.description: Remote gate approval or rejection result.

delivery-doc.description: Delivery summary for a PR-bound run.

pr-info.description: Pull request URL, title, and body metadata.
